text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: —Here it is.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Haaaaaaaaaah!
—Fufu...!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —Mejiro Ramonu, absolutely breathtaking! Conquering the Victoria Mile with utter perfection!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"The Goddess of Victory smiles upon her—no,
was she herself the Goddess of Victory all along?!
She's in a league of her own, Mejiro Ramonu...!"
(Waaaaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone will watch.
This is fine.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
I knew it... it's no good.
—It's so frustrating...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
You're going to get stronger and stronger...
Shine brighter... far into the distance...!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text: So... that's why, I—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with White Ornament
text_block_list.text:
...I can't help but admire you.
To look up to you—

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"—A masterclass from Mejiro Ramonu!
With flawless dominance,
she claims the Victoria Mile!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
Ramonu... you really are fascinating!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
...May I get back to work now?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, you're pretty calm.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Didn't you feel something too?
From the way she ran.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Ramonu will bring even greater excitement to the racing world.
That is how I feel."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: After seeing her run today, the Mejiro family will probably hold off on making demands of her for a while.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
Then you too—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I am inundated with tasks and still have things to do.
I apologize, but please continue this in your own room.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Okaaaay...

text_block_list.name: TV Noise
text_block_list.text:
"Let's take a look at the replay.
Mejiro Ramonu started off in this position—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Ouzu.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Turning down an offer from a girl who runs that beautifully...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Or rather, is it fine if I choose instead?
If 'this' is—"

When Mejiro Ramonu returned,
she wore a satisfied expression.
She even seemed somewhat elated.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Say...
The Senior Class is quite interesting, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I get to compete against girls
with all kinds of different strengths.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"Love taking so many different forms...
It's delightful to see."
choice_data_list: Then the next race will be even more exciting.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: The Takarazuka Kinen.

The Takarazuka Kinen is a Grand Prix race attracting
the most popular Umamusume. Up until now, she had
primarily competed on an extension of the Tiara route, but—
choice_data_list: Girls on the Classic route will be aiming for this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I do hope they prove to be...
worth sinking my teeth into.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
“—There is no way I could overlook
such a magnificent, blooming flower.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Right?

Our next target race is the Takarazuka Kinen...
There, we'll engrave Mejiro Ramonu's unchanging dominance, no matter who her opponents may be!
